_comment: Chapter 14 recipe 49 (WI-0.553): one byte edit per chapter 7 section 7.9 SYN diagnostic code. tools/corrupt.py
--condition CODE applies edit to input_file (the output of recipe input) and writes syn_broken_syntax_<CODE>;
--all-codes writes them all. Bit positions count RBSP bits from bit 0 of the NAL unit header. not_in_table
names every other SYN code of section 7.9.3 and why it has no entry; tools/tests checks that the two lists

conditions.why: vps_reserved_0xffff_16bits (f(16)) reads 0x0000
an emulation prevention byte followed by 0x04 in the first slice of picture 1
reserved_zero_2bits = 3
every NAL unit removed: an empty file
no SPS or PPS anywhere (SYN-H264-0010 follows)
forbidden_zero_bit = 1 on the first SEI
the PPS removed (same edit as syn_broken_h264_missing_pps)
the PPS moved before its SPS
the SEIs of the first access unit (buffering_period first) moved before the SPS
the first slice repeated: a second first_mb_in_slice 0 in the same picture
reference picture 1 removed: frame_num jumps by 2, gaps not allowed
nuh_temporal_id_plus1 = 0 on the first prefix SEI
the SPS cut to 9 bytes (same edit as syn_broken_h265_truncated_sps)
vps_max_sub_layers_minus1 = 7 (allowed 0..6)
pps_pic_parameter_set_id = 64
the first prefix SEI's payloadType set to 132 (decoded picture hash, suffix only)
first_slice_segment_in_pic_flag = 0 on the only slice of picture 1
picture 1 (a reference of the following pictures) removed
obu_has_size_field = 0 on the sequence header, which is followed by more OBUs
the KEY frame OBU of the first temporal unit removed after its sequence header
the temporal delimiter of TU 2 removed: TU 1 has two shown frames
TUs 1 and 2 under one temporal_unit_size: two temporal delimiters inside it
the KEY frame OBU of TU 0 keeps half of its tile data (obu_size consistent)
no KEY frame: the inter frame of TU 1 names empty slots (same edit as SYN-AV1-0003)
level_idc = 10 (Level 1, MaxFS 99) on a 1280x720 stream
